integrity: Proof and independently reconstructed moments are included; finite Monte Carlo checks are corroboration and not a proof. All claimed signs follow from algebra and asymptotic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent matched-mean on/off Erlang residence clocks, deterministic-clock limit, harmonic overdamped dynamics, and stationary complete-cycle event indexing; does not classify all renewal laws or fixed physical-time work correlations. For Erlang shape at least four only existence, not uniqueness, of a sign crossing is proved. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: A three-stage clock threshold for the sign of cycle-resolved work memory in a flashing harmonic trap
